changeSet.comment: fk_catalog_chunks_chunk: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, collection, chash) REFERENCES nexus.chunks (tenant_id, collection, chash) ON UPDATE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE NOT VALID. ON UPDATE CASCADE is mandatory (F10a: chunks is the parent; collection rename / chash rekey are parent-key UPDATEs that must propagate). No explicit ON DELETE action (defaults to NO ACTION, the only PostgreSQL action that can be deferred — RESTRICT cannot, F8a) plus DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE (F10b): statement-local error locality everywhere except the two class-B call sites, which opt into SET CONSTRAINTS ... DEFERRED explicitly (catalog-029-3 below; CatalogRepository.deleteCollectionTxn, Java-side). NOT VALID: enforces every new write immediately; retroactive validation of pre-existing rows is catalog-029-1 (remediate) then catalog-029-2 (VALIDATE).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.catalog_document_chunks ADD CONSTRAINT fk_catalog_chunks_chunk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, collection, chash) REFERENCES nexus.chunks (tenant_id, collection, chash) ON UPDATE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE NOT VALID;
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE nexus.catalog_document_chunks DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_catalog_chunks_chunk;

changeSet.author: nexus-o8dil.29
changeSet.comment: Delete every catalog_document_chunks row whose (tenant_id, collection, chash) has no matching nexus.chunks row — an anti-join against the chunk store (F17), never a count comparison. Closes the second boot-brick (amendment x/xi) for every future late-upgrading deployment, not just the release that first ships this file. RLS toggle-wrapped (nexus-1wjmq shape): both catalog_document_chunks and nexus.chunks carry FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and Liquibase's nexus_admin owner is not BYPASSRLS, so both are toggled off for the DELETE and restored before this changeset ends. The deleted-row count is surfaced via RAISE NOTICE, which Liquibase's JdbcExecutor captures from the JDBC Statement's SQLWarning chain and logs through its own (SLF4J-backed) logger by default (SHOW_SQL_WARNING_MESSAGES defaults true) -- no runAlways, no DDL-in-Python, no bespoke Java capture.

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_catalog_chunks_chunk'

changeSet.comment: VALIDATE fk_catalog_chunks_chunk — retroactively check pre-existing rows now that catalog-029-1 has remediated any dangling population. Guarded by a whole-changeset precondition (nexus-4m6i0.13/nexus-ms57z shape 1, same as fk-002-7..11/fk-003-7..11): skips (marks ran, once) instead of hard-ERRORing a crash-loop boot on any box where the constraint doesn't exist. All three catalog-029 changesets ship together in one file/release, so this guard is expected to be a permanent no-op in practice (catalog-029-0 always runs first in the same walk) — it is added purely to satisfy the project's blanket "every bare VALIDATE CONSTRAINT is guarded" tripwire (tests/test_changelog_validate_precondition_lint.py), which does not carve out a same-release exception.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.catalog_document_chunks VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_catalog_chunks_chunk;

changeSet.author: nexus-o8dil.29
changeSet.comment: CREATE OR REPLACE nexus.purge_trash(older_than interval): adds SET CONSTRAINTS fk_catalog_chunks_chunk DEFERRED right after the GUC guard, before Step 1 -- Step 1 deletes FROM nexus.chunks while the manifest rows that reference those chunks still exist (they are removed later, in Step 4, via fk-001's CASCADE off catalog_documents, in the SAME function call / transaction). Without deferring, Step 1's DELETE would raise fk_catalog_chunks_chunk immediately for every chunk it deletes (F8a/F10b, site L1-L3). Also pins SET search_path = nexus, public at the function level: unlike every other statement in this body (already schema-qualified), SET CONSTRAINTS's constraint_name has no schema-qualification syntax in Postgres -- it resolves via the CALLING session's search_path. Production nexus_svc connections get "nexus" on their search_path via HikariCP connection properties, but any other caller (a superuser session with the Postgres default search_path, an ad-hoc psql session, a test harness's raw JDBC connection) does not, and SET CONSTRAINTS fk_catalog_chunks_chunk DEFERRED then fails with "constraint fk_catalog_chunks_chunk does not exist" even though the constraint is right there on nexus.catalog_document_chunks. Pinning the function's own search_path makes the fix caller-independent, exactly like the schema-qualification already used everywhere else in this body. Everything else is byte-for-byte identical to vectors-005-15 -- that changeset already shipped and is checksum-immutable, layered on via CREATE OR REPLACE per the catalog-024-on-023 / catalog-026-on-catalog-003-5 discipline.
